key_point: The marriage proposal hidden in Spider-Man
title: The marriage proposal hidden in Spider-Man
caption: A fan's marriage proposal was hidden in Marvel's Spider-Man, then the couple broke up before launch. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #spiderman #marvelsspiderman

instagram.caption:
Fan Tyler Schultz asked Insomniac to hide a proposal in Marvel's Spider-Man. They put MADDIE WILL YOU MARRY ME? on a theater marquee.

Then the couple broke up before release, and players found the sign anyway.

Insomniac offered to patch it. Tyler asked for a tribute to his late grandmother, who gave him his first Spider-Man comic.

Would you have kept the sign?
